notes: Two entry kinds. LIVE API (apiURL + paths, optional liftList/trailList per-facility detail lists): verified public JSON endpoints fetched directly by the app; every entry must pass Scripts/validate-status-sources.py before shipping. REPORT LINK ONLY (reportURL, no apiURL): the resort's own snow-report/conditions page, opened in SafariView from the Conditions link card; discovered+verified by Scripts/find-report-pages.py. Lift/trail status for 185 resorts comes from the SELF-HOSTED Liftie pipeline (BSD-3, github.com/pirxpilot/liftie): a Raspberry Pi runs Liftie locally and publishes each resort's API JSON (plus top-level fetchedAt, bumped only when the lifts payload changes) to github.com/orlandocastiglioni/indiepeaks-lift-status every 15 min; the app reads raw.githubusercontent.com (no bot wall, CDN-backed). Hosted liftie.info itself is Cloudflare-challenged for app clients since 2026-07-07 -- never point apiURL back at it. Pipeline entries carry only the paths their payload actually has: nordic centres publish no lifts (omit liftsOpen/liftsTotal/liftList -- a permanently-zero lift counter reads as a closed mountain), and resorts whose page lists no difficulty publish trails.list as a {name: status} map, so their trailList is a bare path with no nameKey/statusKey/levelKey. middlebury-snowbowl, tyrol-basin and pine-mountain have Pi-side parsers but are deliberately not enabled -- do not add entries until a status file exists. The pipeline entries are GENERATED -- run Scripts/sync-status-sources.py to rebuild them from the live feed (it reads the feed's own _index.json/_health.json, resolves roster ids, and carries reportURL/fallbackTotals across), then Scripts/validate-status-sources.py to gate. Hand-edit only the report-link-only entries and the two native-API ones (saddleback-mountain, pebble-creek-ski-area), which the generator will not touch. Full contract: docs/status-sources.md. fallbackTotals inventory: bundled Indy stats cross-checked with OpenSkiMap (data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL). 2026-09-02: the six 26/27 roster additions are report-link-only or absent -- no public JSON API exists for any of them (Scripts/find-status-apis.py: 0 verified, 0 leads, kandatsu blocked) and none has a parseable lift/trail source, so skeetawk, scotts-cobble-nordic-center and pyha-ski-resort carry the conditions URL Indy's own resort page links, and frost-fire-park, ski-land and kandatsu-snow-resort carry NO entry (they fall back to websiteURL -- Ski Land's own site sends people to Facebook for lift status and kandatsu.com 403s every scripted client). Recon: indiepeaks-lift-status/docs/new-resorts-2026-27-recon.md. Also fixed three entries that were fetching 404s: dog-creek-lodge-nordic-center now points at the roster-id filename the feed actually publishes, and west-mountain + white-pass were demoted to report-link-only after disappearing from the feed entirely. 2026-09-03 (second 26/27 announcement): five more report-link entries -- eastman-cross-country, kendall-mountain-ski-area, mont-kanasuta, ruka-ski-resort, togari-onsen-snow-resort -- each the URL Indy's own resort page links as "Conditions". Two of them point at aggregators the Liftie pipeline ALREADY parses for other resorts and are therefore the batch's live-status candidates: mont-kanasuta -> maneige.ski (same host as mont-habitant/vallee-bleue, fetched Pi-side via flaresolverr -- it 403s every scripted client including a browser UA, which is why it is report-link-only in the app and why that 403 is NOT a dead link) and eastman-cross-country -> nordic-pulse.com (same aggregator as rikert, manning-park-xc and the other Nordic Pulse areas). king-pine needed no status change: it was already live on the pipeline before it was promoted from Allied to a full partner. 2026-09-04 (third 26/27 announcement): four more report-link entries -- engstligenalp, powder-ridge-ct, showdown-montana, skigebiet-heiligenblut-grossglockner. powderridgepark.com 403s scripted clients (SafariView-exempt, like pats-peak and maneige.ski). jay-peak-resort needed no change: it is already live on the pipeline, and its 26/27 change was gaining cross-country (type alpine-xc + indyXC) rather than a new entry -- its pipeline file publishes lifts only, so the XC trails are not represented yet. NOTE the roster now has TWO Powder Ridges: powder-ridge-mn (Kimball MN, powderridge.com, live on the pipeline as status/powder-ridge-mn.json) and powder-ridge-ct (Middlefield CT, powderridgepark.com, report-link only). The hosts differ, so sync-status-sources.py's host match keeps them apart -- do not hand-wire either to the other's file. This is the crystal-mountain MI/WA trap with a second pair. 2026-09-05 (fourth 26/27 announcement): two more report-link entries -- ski-saint-bruno and st-johann-in-tirol, each the URL Indy's own resort page links as "Conditions". mt-pisgah and osceola-tug-hill-xc-ski-center get NO entry on purpose: Indy links no conditions page for either, and neither site has one (the Village of Saranac Lake's Mt Pisgah page publishes hours only; uxcski.com has about/hours/directions/trail-map and no snow report), so both correctly fall back to websiteURL. granby-ranch needed no change -- it is already live on the pipeline, and its 26/27 news was gaining cross-country (type alpine-xc + indyXC) rather than a new entry, so like jay-peak its published file is alpine-side only.
